purpose: R775 retrieval for long-prefill transfer choice; read-only review.

known_vs_new.R572_already_known: 512 async expert copies, one checked drain after the batch; no per-copy wait. No explicit shim memcpy does not rule out driver staging.
known_vs_new.R775_adds: General direct/merge/pack/gather crossover and lifetime/byte/dependency cautions; no threshold or Arc result, and no proof the current 512 rows bottleneck. R776 calls the 144x5 matrix too broad.

source_facts.src/prefill/layer_major.inc:216,242-254,: stride=align_up(max_blob,256); one owned new[] slab of NE*stride; copy_blob writes bytes at e*stride; NE fills then one checked drain.
source_facts.src/core/expert_cache.cpp:215-241,346-37: Uniform open_uninitialized cache uses base+e*stride. fill_slot copies exactly bytes and increments fills_; batch path must preserve fills_/stats, errors and lease lifetime.
source_facts.src/core/expert_source.cpp:567-571,1173-: Both copy_blob variants write valid bytes only; upload padding is uninitialized.
source_facts.src/sycl/compat.cpp:255-286: cudaMemcpyAsync queues one contiguous q.memcpy. cudaMemcpy2DAsync loops height times over q.memcpy; it is not a native rectangle.
source_facts./usr/include/level_zero/ze_api.h:4915-49: Pitched region API; source/dest must be device-accessible in its context; unsupported-feature is a possible result.

decision.first_screen: For bytes==stride layers compare 512 fill_slot calls with one opt-in H2D of NE*stride; host/device rows are contiguous, so payload, owner, map and one checked drain stay exact. Preserve fill/stat accounting, errors, cancellation and lease. Skip if no equality layer.
decision.bytes_lt_stride: A true rectangle (width=bytes, height=NE, both pitches=stride) copies exact payload in one region. Core SYCL memcpy is 1D and the current 2D shim still emits NE calls. Level Zero zeCommandListAppendMemoryCopyRegion takes pitched regions, but its installed public header requires device-accessible pointers in the same context, live/unmodified until completion; it can return UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE. The current upload source is ordinary new[] and its eligibility is unproven. One API spelling/append proves neither runtime lowering nor speed.
decision.control_and_guardrails: Keep 512 exact-width copies as control. Never send NE*stride when bytes<stride: host padding is uninitialized. Do not change shared cudaMemcpy2DAsync; legacy Q/gate D2D callers are layer.cpp, verify.cpp and mtp.cpp. New path is long-prefill-only. Defer packing: it adds host work/ownership and needs device scatter or layout changes; later count all bytes/commands and full-path time.

historical_profile.identity: Old instrumented BF16-prefix, not current tilepack; n=1.
historical_profile.limit: Queue and issuer intervals overlap; do not subtract/add as independent savings. No physical bus counters; motivation only, not proof of saturation or current-binary speed.

prerequisites: Active layout table: bytes, stride, equality/short counts, valid bytes and padding delta; pin current binary and SYCL/UR/L0 identity.
Count native copy appends through the same checked drain; verify row bytes, slots, fill/stat counts, errors and owner lifetime.
For narrow rows, prove the actual rectangle accepts this new[] source and device slots in-context without changing ownership; else omit it.
small_screen.comparison: Representative bytes==stride layer: 512 copies vs one bulk copy. For narrower rows, test a true rectangle only if pointer eligibility is proven. Keep H2D bytes equal; measure issuer CPU, completion and full path. Adoption also needs a fresh matched current-binary boundary and repeated clean samples.

eligibility.reason: Missing active width census, current tilepack native-command attribution, and same-pointer rectangle evidence. Record these first; new research would only repeat missing local evidence.
